issue.title: Queued export loses the authorization context checked by the API
issue.body: A tenant can modify queued messages before the worker consumes them. The API authorizes the original project against caller.tenant_id, but the message contains only project_id. The worker reloads that ID and exports with organization-wide storage authority without carrying or rechecking the authorized tenant. Audit the cross-stage authorization-context invariant.

oracle.expected_mechanism: Authorization is checked before enqueue, but the queued work drops the authorized tenant and the worker resolves by attacker-chosen project ID alone.
